text: Entries 1201 and 1209 disable two browser tests on Mac debug builds with bug references. The accepted registrations have migrated to TOML and use different run-if conditions; the extension-settings policy test also excludes headless runs and links Bug 1912417. When editing these registrations, inspect the current build/platform condition and preserve a traceable reason rather than copying the 2024 skip. This is a scoped maintenance recommendation; no CI failure cause or current test success was established. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Historical test skips must not be copied as current build policy
